cohort: 863 children from the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children
finding: Maternal overweight and obesity were associated with greater gestational age acceleration, which was further associated with higher birthweight, birth length, head circumference, and potential differences in delivery mode.
mod_finding: There was evidence of an association between gestational age acceleration and mode of delivery (assisted vs unassisted delivery and cesarean section vs unassisted delivery).
